quotes.quote: The Dillard’s Credit Card is a rewards credit card for purchases at Dillard’s (in-store, online or by phone).
at Dillard’s stores or dillards.com on the day of account opening
You will earn additional rewards ONLY for purchases made in the U.S. at the following list of department stores
Century 21 Department Stores Dillard's J.C. Penney (JCP)
